key_findings: RestaurantFloor (restaurant.floor) and RestaurantTable (restaurant.table) both inherit pos.load.mixin and are added to session load list in PosSession._load_pos_data_models when module_pos_restaurant is active.
RestaurantTable supports self-referential parent_id for physical table merging. Merged child tables derive their screen coordinates from the parent rather than storing them independently.
PosOrder gains table_id (btree_not_null partial index), customer_count, and course_ids. _get_open_order is overridden to prevent duplicate orders when concurrent waiters hit the same table.
RestaurantOrderCourse carries fired bool + fired_date auto-stamp, uuid (uuid4), index, and one-to-many line_ids. create/write overrides auto-stamp fired_date.
PosOrderLine gains nullable course_id (ondelete='set null'). Deleting a course releases its lines without cascading.
Bill splitting preserves course structure: split lines are placed into matching-index courses in the new order. A 26-part alphabetic suffix limit applies.
Course firing auto-fires the first unfired course on sendOrderInPreparation. addCourse assigns existing lines to the first course and creates a second empty course for new items.
Device synchronisation patch resolves concurrent waiter conflicts by merging duplicate table orders client-side.
Receipt/preparation ticket grouping is patched to use course index+name as group header instead of product category.
No Community pos_kitchen_display module found. Kitchen integration is limited to preparation printer dispatch. AWT observation needed for kitchen display runtime behavior.
